scenes.title: Part 1
scenes.caption: Part 1 · Sunset Run Club (sports)
runbook: No sims. Title card only.

scenes.title: Create room, clear edge
scenes.caption: Room settings never hide under the Create button.
scenes.highlight: Hairline and gap above Create room, AI switch just above it
scenes.check: ✓ AI switch fully visible; gap separates it from Create (fix i)
runbook: Mina 91F3: Rooms → Create room; scroll the settings down to the AI switch; hold so the hairline and gap above Create room are in frame.

scenes.title: Same edge in dark
scenes.caption: Same clear edge in dark mode.
scenes.highlight: Separator line above Create room in dark mode
scenes.check: ✓ Separator visible in dark mode (fix i)
runbook: Sora 6E0F (dark mode): Rooms → Create room; scroll to the bottom; capture the separator above Create room; back out without creating.

scenes.title: Invite code
scenes.caption: Start a temporary room in seconds.
scenes.highlight: 5-digit code and QR
scenes.check: ✓ Room created with a 5-digit code
runbook: Mina 91F3: create the meetup room; capture the 5-digit code and QR sheet.

scenes.title: Friends join
scenes.caption: Friends join by code or QR, no sign-up.
scenes.highlight: Each phone lands in the chat
scenes.check: ✓ 4 guests joined by code
runbook: Jun F11B: Join → enter Mina's code.
Sora 6E0F: Join → enter the code.
Leo 99A2: Join → enter the code.
Dani 56FB: Join → enter the code.
Capture each phone landing in the chat.

scenes.title: Target pace prefill
scenes.caption: Your target starts from your usual pace.
scenes.highlight: Target pace field (prefill, or muted "e.g. 5:30" with Save disabled)
scenes.check: ✓ Prefilled with usual pace; empty field cannot be saved (fix j)
runbook: Dani 56FB: Pace card → Set target; capture the prefilled usual pace; clear the field to show Save disabled; restore.

scenes.title: Arrived
scenes.caption: Arrivals show up for everyone.
scenes.highlight: "X arrived" notices in the chat
scenes.check: ✓ 4 arrival notices
runbook: Jun F11B, Sora 6E0F, Leo 99A2, Dani 56FB in that order: tap Arrived.
Capture the arrival notices in the chat (Mina 91F3 view).

scenes.title: Arrival count
scenes.highlight: "5 people · 4 arrived" on Info
scenes.check: ✓ 5 people · 4 arrived
runbook: Mina 91F3: open Info; capture "5 people · 4 arrived".

scenes.title: Arrivals survive restart
scenes.caption: Arrivals count for the meetup, not each activity.
scenes.highlight: Info count after End → Start activity
scenes.check: ✓ Still 4 arrived after End → Start activity (fix c)
runbook: Mina 91F3: End activity → Start activity; reopen Info; capture still 4 arrived.

scenes.title: Pace groups
scenes.caption: Pace cues keep the group together.
scenes.highlight: Map groups and Dani's lead-group cue
scenes.check: ✓ Lead group 150 m ahead → Dani caught up
runbook: All five start the activity with simulated locations: Mina 91F3 and Jun F11B in the lead group, Dani 56FB 150 m behind.
Dani 56FB: capture the lead-group cue; move Dani's location up until caught up.
Mina 91F3: capture the map groups.

scenes.title: Emergency
scenes.caption: Emergency reaches everyone at once.
scenes.highlight: Red Emergency banner, then "Seen by Mina"
scenes.check: ✓ Seen by Mina → resolved
runbook: Leo 99A2: tap Emergency.
Mina 91F3, Jun F11B, Sora 6E0F, Dani 56FB: capture the red banner.
Mina 91F3: open it ("Seen by Mina").
Leo 99A2: resolve.

scenes.title: Ask: where is everyone
scenes.caption: Ask Qrewing knows where the group is.
scenes.highlight: Answer text naming the lead group and "you"
scenes.check: ✓ Says you are moving; names lead group Mina and Jun (fixes b, h)
runbook: Dani 56FB: Ask Qrewing "Where is everyone?"; capture the answer naming the lead group and "you".

scenes.title: Ask: emergency history
scenes.caption: It remembers what happened in the room.
scenes.highlight: Answer naming Leo's Emergency
scenes.check: ✓ Names Leo's Emergency and that it was resolved (fix a)
runbook: Sora 6E0F (dark): Ask Qrewing about the emergency; capture the answer naming Leo's Emergency and that it was resolved.

scenes.title: Recap
scenes.caption: A recap when the room ends; data is deleted after.
scenes.highlight: Recap pace lines and the Emergency line
scenes.check: ✓ Recap includes pace and the Emergency (fix a)
runbook: Mina 91F3: request the recap; capture the pace lines and the Emergency line.

runbook: No sims. Title card only.

scenes.title: Entry questions
scenes.caption: Hosts choose what guests share.
scenes.highlight: Red * and Required switch on "Looking for"
scenes.check: ✓ "Looking for" marked required
runbook: Mina 91F3: create the event room with entry questions; set "Looking for" Required; capture the red *.

scenes.title: Required answer check
scenes.caption: Required answers are checked in place.
scenes.highlight: Inline error under "Headline"
scenes.check: ✓ Answer "Headline". → saved
runbook: Jun F11B: join; leave "Headline" empty and submit; capture the inline error; answer and save.

scenes.title: People to meet
scenes.caption: Qrewing suggests who to meet.
scenes.highlight: Sora and Leo cards with reasons
scenes.check: ✓ Jun → Sora + Leo
runbook: Sora 6E0F and Leo 99A2: join and answer the entry questions first.
Jun F11B: open People to meet; capture the Sora and Leo cards with reasons.

scenes.title: Mute small talk
scenes.caption: Mute small talk, keep what matters.
scenes.highlight: "2 messages hidden · Show" and the Announcement
scenes.check: ✓ 2 small-talk messages hidden; the announcement stays
runbook: Jun F11B and Sora 6E0F: send two small-talk messages.
Mina 91F3: post the announcement.
Leo 99A2 and Dani 56FB: Mute small talk on; capture "2 messages hidden · Show" with the announcement visible.

scenes.title: Host message
scenes.highlight: "Important: From the host" banner
scenes.check: ✓ Host message flagged important
runbook: Mina 91F3: send a host message marked important.
Jun F11B: capture the "Important: From the host" banner.

scenes.title: Ask: posted time
scenes.caption: Answers use when things were said.
scenes.highlight: Answer time relative to the posted message, "you posted"
scenes.check: ✓ Time counted from the posted message; "you posted" (fixes g, h)
runbook: Leo 99A2: post a message, wait, then Ask Qrewing about it; capture the time counted from the post and "you posted".

scenes.title: Photos of me
scenes.caption: Photos of me, matched only in this room.
scenes.highlight: Each Me tab showing only that person
scenes.check: ✓ Each Me tab shows only that person; 0 false positives (Sora: upper-body shot only, p04_full_body_01/02 left out per the human's 2026-11-13 decision; fill in the counts from the take)
runbook: Each phone: enroll a reference selfie (Sora 6E0F: upper-body shot only; no p04_full_body photos).
Mina 91F3: upload the room photo set (without p04_full_body_01/02).
Mina 91F3, Jun F11B, Sora 6E0F, Leo 99A2, Dani 56FB: open the Me tab; capture each showing only that person.

scenes.title: Siri
scenes.caption: Ask hands-free with Siri.
scenes.highlight: Siri answer panel
scenes.check: ✓ Siri answered from the room
runbook: Dani 56FB (iOS 27.2): ask Siri about the room; capture the Siri answer panel.

scenes.title: Room ends
scenes.caption: When it ends, it's really gone.
scenes.highlight: Recap and the deletion note
scenes.check: ✓ Recap ready; room deleted after grace
runbook: Mina 91F3: End room; capture the recap and the deletion note.

scenes.title: Part 3
scenes.caption: Qrewing Calendar (Plus preview)
runbook: No sims. Title card only.

scenes.title: Recap lands on the calendar
scenes.caption: Every meetup becomes a day on your calendar.
scenes.highlight: Highlighter bar with the AI emoji on the room's dates
scenes.check: ✓ Room shows as a highlighter bar with the recap emoji
runbook: Before the take, Mina 91F3: Profile → Plan preview → "Try Plus preview on this phone" ON (hold the switch: axe touch --down --up --delay 0.4).
Mina 91F3: in the meetup room, request the recap before the room closes.
Mina 91F3: Rooms → calendar icon; capture the room's highlighter bar with the AI emoji.

scenes.title: Tap for the diary
scenes.caption: Qrewing writes a 3-line diary of the day.
scenes.highlight: The 3-line diary card
scenes.check: ✓ Tapping the bar shows the 3-line diary
runbook: Mina 91F3: tap the room's day; open the room in the day list; capture the 3-line diary.

scenes.title: Add an event
scenes.caption: Add your own plans with +.
scenes.highlight: The new event on its day
scenes.check: ✓ Manual event saved and shown
runbook: Mina 91F3: tap +; fill title, dates and emoji; Save; capture the new event in the month and day list.

scenes.title: Add by asking
scenes.caption: Or just ask Qrewing to add it.
scenes.highlight: Qrewing sheet request and the added event
scenes.check: ✓ Qrewing added the requested event
runbook: Mina 91F3: tap the Qrewing button on the calendar; type an add request (e.g. "Add brunch with Jun next Saturday 11am"); confirm; capture the event on its day.

scenes.title: Overlapping meetups
scenes.caption: Overlapping rooms stack, never hide.
scenes.highlight: Two stacked lanes, or "+N" on a full day
scenes.check: ✓ Two overlapping rooms show as stacked lanes (or +N)
runbook: Before the take, Mina 91F3: create a second room whose dates overlap the meetup room (Jun F11B joins it so it has a member).
Mina 91F3: open the calendar on those dates; capture the stacked lanes or the "+N".
